detail: Guarded Writer v0.1.4 requires execution-authorisation.json to be readable from the deployed plugin directory. The configured reader and writer identities have only their narrow custom capabilities and cannot install plugin files. No SSH, WP-CLI, SFTP, deployment credential, or connected WordPress Admin browser is available.

execution_contract.reason: A local-only file would not satisfy the live server check and would make the tested package-source boundary misleading.

required_external_state: Install the one-time exact execution-authorisation.json into the deployed guarded-writer v0.1.4 plugin directory through an approved secure deployment channel, without replacing or changing plugin PHP code.
